override.scope: Waives the Step 2 entry-gate requirement that every impl_evidence check be PASS-or-N/A, for the unit_tests dimension ONLY. Every other dimension genuinely passed. The verdict field is intentionally left BLOCKED -- this is a documented waiver, not a re-judgement.
justification: The 6 failing files are perf-budget tests in services/api/tests/perf/, none owned by SHP-02 and none in its file_plan.
Proven code-independent by controlled A/B: the evidence pass stashed SHP-02 out entirely (git stash push -u) and reproduced the same failure pool with the story absent, then restored.

Failure signature is scheduler starvation, not slow code: ING-01-TC-22 measured p95=19.6613ms against a 10ms budget with min=0.8593ms and max=177.6791ms -- the fast path is 12x under budget and only tail outliers breach it. A real regression would lift the minimum.
Machine load at override time: 87.68 on 8 cores (~11x oversubscribed), from 32 concurrent claude processes plus VS Code -- none of them SHP-02's.

Everything SHP-02 owns is green under that same load: test_personal_usage.py 5/5, test_personal_usage_perf.py 3/3 (3 SELECTs flat, 104-325ms vs a 2000ms budget), test_migrations.py 12/12, test_models.py 46/46, test_format.py 31/31.
override.packet_staleness: The packet predates F-15 (tests/unit/test_format.py, the AF-02 accepted fix applied after the pass ran), so it does not describe the current tree. That delta was verified independently: ruff clean, mypy clean, pytest 31 passed. No other source file changed after the pass.
override.residual_risk: A genuine regression hiding inside one of the 6 quarantined perf files would not be caught by this run. Mitigated but not eliminated by the A/B; the honest re-test is a full suite run on an unloaded machine.
